name: Arcade 8-Bit
description: Coin-op arcade: pixel type, neon cyan, magenta, yellow and green on black, scanlines and pixel grids, square out lights. Player Select cards with segmented stat bars, an INSERT COIN between-innings screen and a GAME OVER final with high scores. Every graphic type, plus basketball, football and hockey.
